Suppliers is a compound multi-business free-text field. Supplier legal names and trading names are not mapped because there is no safe per-party attribution; names such as 'Orion Laboratories T/A Perrigo Australia' and 'Speedy School Supplies (Loveld Pty Ltd t/a)' show trading-name/legal-name ambiguity.
The ABN regex is anchored to the 'ABN:' label. Rows where the ABN is absent or unlabelled produce no claims. The regex pattern is not expected to match the 'TBA' or list-only rows.
Address, phone and email fragments inside Suppliers are not mapped to address.* because they are not attributable to a specific party.
ABN checksum validity is unverified in training data (checksum_valid_abn = 0 across all fields); the abn transform will validate at ingest and reject invalid checksums.
Source is a government procurement directory; the supplier identifier is an ABN as stated in the source, derivation level L0. No ACN is mapped and no ACN is inferred from ABN.
